summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT). Fine-tuned and quantized open source models, including TinyLlama 1.1B, DONUT, and YOLOv8, cutting GPU memory footprint by ~55% through 8-bit quantization with under 1% accuracy loss across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC benchmarks. Owned a voice-controlled robotic pipeline end to end on Jetson hardware, shipping TensorRT-optimized inference (5.2x speedup) and driving it to 100% field reliability through iterative failure resolution.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT, an open source OCR-free document transformer, on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction using Hugging Face Transformers.
Built training and preprocessing pipelines in PyTorch, adding domain-specific tokenization and resizing decoder embeddings to fit the target schema.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% through iterative preprocessing and fine-tuning refinements.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom detection dataset and trained YOLOv8n, an open source model, achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation.
Exported the trained model to ONNX and TFLite for on-device mobile deployment.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation models with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones on the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset.
Built an evaluation framework using Dice Score and IoU benchmarks to report accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B, an open source language model; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types.
Built an evaluation benchmark suite across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; achieved under 1% accuracy degradation with a 0.09 perplexity increase, near lossless compression.
Evaluated efficiency versus task performance trade-offs to guide edge deployment decisions.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Owned a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system end to end, from model integration through on-device deployment on Jetson.
Deployed TensorRT-optimized YOLO for visual servoing, a 5.2x inference speedup (56.7→10.9 ms) over eager PyTorch.
Diagnosed and resolved 11 integration failures, reaching 100% pick reliability across 10 field trials.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch with a custom tokenizer and training loop, evaluating training via perplexity tracking.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built an end-to-end ASR pipeline with a causal Transformer decoder and a Cython-accelerated BPE tokenizer (4–5.5x speedup), benchmarked at 15% WER.
